{{Top|leg}}
'''Thermite''' was a material usually used in conjunction with [[axidite]] to make the shell casing of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. It was also found in the explosive cores of certain types of grenades. It was a substance that takes the form of black sand that, while not actually explosive, when fire was applied, could burn to temperatures of up to 2500 degrees centigrade.<ref name="GN">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref><ref name="EG">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
